newsitem.title: USA: Stiglitz says US employment gains sustainable - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Stiglitz says US employment gains sustainable - RFTV.

text.p: White House economic adviser Joseph Stiglitz Friday said he believed the employment gains of the past year will be sustainable going into 1997.
Interviewed on Reuters Financial Television, Stiglitz said the number could vary in the period ahead but that it should remain in the same general area.
Earlier the Labor Department reported that unemployment in December held steady at 5.3 percent as the economy created 262,000 new jobs.

"Obviously there is going to be some variation in the employment rate from month to month, the overall strength of the economy has been very clear (and) has been based on a strong sustainable basis, strong investment," he said.
He added that the underlying fundamentals of the "economy are very, very good."
Asked whether the increases in average hourly earnings, which rose six cents in December, were inflationary, he maintained that at present levels, there was no reason to expect new pressures.
